description: R08 functional closeout cohort for the five remaining portable host TextBuffer contracts. Rust now owns the deterministic cross-owner behavior for right-edge VT backspace output, complete multi-row word boundaries, wide-glyph-aware text rectangles, the full CopyRequest plain-text matrix, and shell command-region remapping across reflow.

entries.notes: The portable host TextBuffer owner reproduces Microsoft's far-right CUB clamp, x/backspace/y overwrite ordering and following-line cursor result over live Rust buffer state.
Rust reproduces Microsoft's complete GetWordStart/GetWordEnd matrices for selection and accessibility modes, including unwrapped, forced-wrap, cross-row whitespace and end-of-buffer cases.
The Rust owner produces Microsoft's exact block and line selection rectangles while expanding boundaries that intersect wide glyph cells.
The Rust CopyRequest owner reproduces the complete wrapped/unwrapped × block/line × CRLF/no-CRLF × trim/preserve-whitespace matrix from Microsoft over live TextBuffer rows.
Shell prompt, command and output mark coordinates are remapped with logical forced-wrap topology and reproduce every Microsoft dx variant (-15, -1, 0, +1, +15), including the +15 unwrap row shift.
